title: Annotatio II §.I: Three opinions — corporal with bread / transubstitution / spiritual to the faithful
pass_a_gloss: When some couple that [presence] Corporally to the bread; Others substitute it for the annihilated substance of the bread; Others finally, the corporal denied, believe a Spiritual [presence] befalls the Spirits of the faithful; all likewise seek the Truth of their opinion from antiquity and labor to build it from that.
pass_b_english: Three camps: some join a corporal presence to the bread; others put Christ’s body in place of annihilated bread-substance; others deny the corporal and credit a spiritual presence to the spirits of the faithful.
All three hunt antiquity to prove their side.
source_text: Istam cum alii Corporalem pani copulent; Alii annihilatae panis substantiae substituant; Alii denique corporali negatâ, Spiritualem Spiritibus fidelium contingere credant; universi etiam Veritatem sententiae suae ab antiquitate petant & ex ea adstruere fatagant.

lemmas.gloss: spiritual to the spirits of the faithful
